pages.text: The Trait Reforger replaces a $(reset)chosen trait in place$(reset) with a new one drawn from the same tier pool.$(br2)$(bold)Three rules:$(reset)$(li)Guaranteed success — always succeeds once materials and energy are supplied, with no random failure$(li)Never damages the organ$(li)Excludes traits the organ already carries, so it never rolls a duplicate$(br2)Requirements: the organ must be $(bold)non-native and set$(reset), carrying at least 1 trait.$(br2)To replace a trait, this is the only in-place swap method.

$(bold)Cost per reroll:$(reset)$(li)Exhausted Crystals: tier × 2 — tier 1/2/3 traits need 2 / 4 / 6 respectively$(li)120,000 life energy$(li)600 ticks (30 seconds)$(br2)$(bold)Note:$(reset) the new trait is drawn from the $(bold)same tier pool$(reset) — a tier-2 pool cannot yield a tier-3 trait.$(br2)When an organ carries several traits, one reroll replaces only one.

Exhausted Crystals are the $(reset)key consumable$(reset) of trait reforging.$(br2)$(bold)Where they come from:$(reset) they are the common byproduct of the Activated Fractionator and the Life Centrifuge — the whole purification chain is under "$(l:akaishi:life_waste)Waste Neutralization$(/l)".$(br2)Each reroll consumes 2-6; stock up in advance, and set up the waste pipe network early for a steady supply.
Crafting: eight Akaishi Ingots around one Exhausted Crystal.

Suggested order: skim the "Safe" and "Aberrant" trait catalogs before reforging; the Exhausted Crystal line is under "Waste Neutralization"; essence and life energy come from the "Life Purifier" chain.
